_comment: The point-lookup path after its allocations were removed: Block::find, which is a second implementation of the iterator's seek and so must agree with it and refuse what it refuses, and the level-0 search, which finds the newest file not yet searched on each pass and must take them newest first. tests/test_block.cpp holds find against seek on every target and on damaged blocks; tests/test_db.cpp reads a key with three versions in three level-0 files, at each snapshot.
